name: Ajak (Hungary)
description: Pale blue field charged at the centre with the town arms of Ajak (a quartered red, blue and green shield with a hammer, ears of grain, a cross and a plough, between green branches) above the name AJAK in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
